note: Rejudged 2026-10-31 by an auditor who authored none of the change. RFC 5303 Section 3.1: "Any system that supports this mechanism SHALL include this option in its Point-to-Point IIH packets." b77067bc31 changed only the call sites in this unit: threeWayTLV and buildP2PHello now take a p2pNeighbor (systemID, extendedCircuitID) instead of a bare SystemID, with the zero value where none was passed before; every assertion is byte-identical and an independent judge approved the change. Verdict unchanged. Earlier judgment follows. Forbidden: a Point-to-Point IIH without TLV 240. internal/plugins/isis/circuit/rfc5303_threeway_test.go::TestISISP2PIIHCarriesThreeWayOption: the IIH buildP2PHello emits (the builder sendP2PHello always uses) must decode with TLV 240 (absent is Fatal); negative: a LAN IIH never carries it.
